data.title: How we work — the SaaSTEMLY milestone process

content.html:
Process

How a project actually runs.

No black boxes. Every engagement follows the same milestone loop: you scope it, you pay for one milestone at a time, you see working software every week, and you decide what happens next.

Start your projectSee pricing
01

Before any code

Discovery and proposal

  1. You submit a project idea

    A form, an email or a call — whatever you have. A rough sketch is enough to start.

  2. Are the requirements clear?

    If they are, we go straight to reviewing your needs. If not, we book a discussion meeting to define the vision together, then look again.

    • YesWe review and discuss your needs
    • Not yetDiscussion meeting to define the vision — then back to this question

  3. We create a custom proposal

    Scope of work, timeline and milestones, and pricing. If you need changes, we revise it and come back — no milestone starts before you accept.

02

Repeats per milestone

The milestone loop

  1. You pay for the current milestone

    One milestone at a time. You are never paying ahead for work that has not been scoped.

  2. We build your features

    Agile sprints with regular check-ins. Clean architecture, tests and review as we go.

  3. We deploy and show progress

    Working software on a real environment — not a slide deck. You see progress every week.

  4. You review our work

    Minor changes are free — one round of adjustments per milestone. Major changes get quoted separately, and you decide whether you want them.

    • PerfectOn to the next milestone
    • Minor changesFree adjustments, then review again
    • Major changesWe quote the additional work — your call
03

After the last milestone

Delivery and beyond

  1. Final project review

    We walk the whole build with you once every milestone is done.

  2. Final payment and handover

    The project is complete, the code and infrastructure are yours.

  3. Maintenance, or the next phase

    We move into a maintenance phase, and if you want additional features we plan the next phase and start the loop again.

What it means for you

Why we work this way.

You are never over-committed

Payment follows milestones, so the most you ever have at risk is the milestone in front of you.

Scope changes are explicit

Minor adjustments are included. Anything larger is quoted before it is built — so the budget never drifts quietly.

Progress is visible

Every milestone ends with something deployed you can click through, not a status report.
